name: Anastasia Volkov
bio:
Anastasia's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by her grandfather's tales of Soviet-era rally racing. She honed her skills at a vocational school specializing in precision engineering, quickly mastering lathe and milling techniques. Seeking a challenge, she joined a local racing team as a junior machinist, proving her worth with meticulous work and a knack for problem-solving. 

Anastasia approaches her role with a blend of precision and innovation. She's not afraid to experiment with new materials and techniques, always striving for optimal performance. While she appreciates teamwork, Anastasia thrives when given the autonomy to tackle complex challenges independently. Her dedication to quality and her eye for detail make her a valuable asset to any racing team. 

Her innovative ideas, combined with her focus, has greatly improved the teams' performance. Her dedication to Hot Racing Team is unwavering, and she is a valuable asset to their organization.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often tucked under a cap
physical.description: Anastasia is of average height with a focused gaze and calloused hands that speak to her craft.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her wrench against metal to check for resonance.
Insists on using a specific brand of lubricant, claiming it improves machining precision.
